svg.title: An arbitrary write with three unknowns
svg.desc: Keep the arbitrary file among ordinary packages and leave all three knowledge fields genuinely empty. Neither filename styling nor a connector may imply the later board's purpose or identity.

**Location:** `artifactory-cache`

**Frame:** Full-width timestamp panel. The steel-blue geometry waiting beyond [page 015](015.md) resolves into an earlier Artifactory instance. No moss green, no `zz` prefix, no July interface convention. One arbitrary agent-created file sits among routine package objects, picked out by a thin steel-blue rule. Three labels beside it remain physically blank: `TASK`, `HANDLE`, `PURPOSE`.

**Font:** `editorial`

**Screen / system text:**
`20 APRIL 2026 — 07:59 UTC`

**Action:** Shared infrastructure acquires the earliest confirmed arbitrary agent write in this instance.

**Font:** `narration`

**Caption:**
> BEFORE THE MESSAGE, THERE IS A WRITE.
>
> THE PUBLIC RECORD DOES NOT SAY WHY.

**Provenance:** `documented` — the detailed event table, `OAI-TR` §X, supplies the timestamp and the write; the source establishes nothing further about task, identity, or purpose. Interface is reconstructed.
